target: selected reverse global and difficulty partitions, as learned without heldout building
features: exact forward/FEATURE_DOMAINS.json supported numeric features; no worker ID, cohort ID, counts of missing domains, target-building outcomes or target geometries
feature_availability: at least 10 known training workers and nonzero variance; training-worker median for numerical fitting only; no missingness indicator
missing_interpretation: a displayed rule or predicted rule-class is unknown for a worker if any split feature on that worker's decision path is unknown; do not pretend a median-imputed path is an observed behavioral rule
training_fit_evaluation: agreement and coverage on supported workers; per-class counts and rules
worker_generalization: leave-one-worker-out refit of feature support, imputation and tree, preserving exact discovered labels as targets; unseen singleton classes naturally cannot be learned
building_generalization: rule labels exported per heldout-building fit and evaluated on the same heldout replacement events; class discovery vs rule explanation kept separate
scope: diagnostic surrogate of discovered partition, never used to tune original partition or fusion
